episodes.title: Into the Mire
episodes.summary: The party answers a strange invitation and finds themselves wading into the Mire of Forgotten Names — a place where deities go to die, and where one is stubbornly refusing to.

episodes.title: The Council of Embers
episodes.summary: An audience with the Council of Embers reveals that the heroes are not the only ones searching for the Forgotten Gods — and that one councilmember already knows more than they should.

episodes.title: Beneath the Ash
episodes.summary: Beneath the ash-choked ruins of an old temple, the party makes contact with something that should not be awake — and a long-buried bargain comes due.
